summary: Temporary non-blocking notifications with queueing, accessible announcements, pause on hover, and dismissal.
whenToUse: Action confirmations (saved, sent) and quick undo.
whenNotToUse: Errors that require user action: use an Alert next to the problem.
Information users need to keep: also show it on the page.

props.name: ToastProvider.maxVisible
props.description: Number of visible toasts; the rest wait in the queue.

props.name: ToastProvider.queue
props.description: External queue for showing toasts from non-React code.

keyboard.action: Reaches the action and close button (the region is a “Notifiche” landmark).

accessibility: Announced through persistent live regions: polite for info/success/warning, assertive for errors.
The timer pauses on hover or focus (WCAG 2.2.1); errors and toasts with an action never disappear on their own.
Focus is not moved: the toast does not interrupt the user.
responsive: Maximum width of 24rem, reduced on narrow screens; positioned with logical properties.
customization: ToastProvider.className; toasts inherit the theme of the nearest ThemeProvider through a portal.
commonMistakes: Using useToast outside ToastProvider: an explicit error is thrown.
Relying on a toast as the only place where critical information appears.

examples.name: Durations
examples.title: Durations, persistent toast, and programmatic dismissal
examples.description: duration in milliseconds or null; dismiss(id) closes a specific toast and onClose counts the dismissals.

examples.name: Placement
examples.title: Placement and queue with maxVisible
examples.description: The placement is controlled by state; with maxVisible={2} the third toast waits in the queue.

limits: No shortcut (e.g. F6) to move focus into the region: it is reachable as a landmark and with Tab.
